# @armave/picomatch-v4 (internal backport)

Temporary internal backport of picomatch 4.0.7 with the single-branch repeated-extglob ReDoS fix proposed in upstream contributor PR #237.

Source: https://github.com/seeibt/picomatch/commit/1bf0d04563cb9ce568cf36efc5f6b7187d9911d5
Upstream project/license: https://github.com/micromatch/picomatch (MIT; see LICENSE).

This package is not an official picomatch release. Internal package version 4.0.8 identifies the backport only.
